Hello there!
Your basecamp progression has been reset and we refunded all Wrenches you spent.
Some rewards have been deleted from the game while others have been added, that’s why you might not find exactly the same as before.
Noticeably, the Toy Box has been removed from the game, you can find more information about this in the 0.4.0 patch notes.
We wish you all a happy robot bashing!
